evidence: Mode of saturated interior pixels on frames 40, 100, 150, 200, 260, 340 at 30 fps

value.description: Neutral grotesque, medium weight, mixed case, tight tracking, ink #262626 on white. Cap height 9.2%H (font about 12.6%H = 7.1%W), line pitch 15.8%H, block about 77%W, left edge fixed at 11.5%W. Fonts inferred: SF Pro Display or Suisse class; Inter Display Medium at -2.5% is the free equivalent.
Same face and size as the body, in #EA4C1C, the ground orange.
Semibold figures with the percent sign in #FAFAF6 on #E94D1C, centred. Enters at 89.5%W (figure height 54.6%H), settles at 34.8%W (21.4%H).
Medium weight, one line, centred, 81%W at rest, cap height 10.3%H. A shorter qualifier line reaches 60.5%W, cap height about 23.5%H, with a subline at 55% opacity, font about 6.5%H.
Real product UI at 1:1: about 1.5-1.9%H caps, regular and semibold, dark and light greys, link blue, a blue send button #3066EE.

composition.value: One element at a time, centred on the frame's horizontal axis, vertical centre near 50%H. Type blocks span 60-90%W, so the frame is either one big block of words or one interface; nothing small floats around them. The interface window takes 84%W and bleeds off the bottom. A hero number at 90%W on a single colour field is the densest frame.

materials.value: Flat: solid colour grounds, vector type, a real light-theme interface with soft shadows. No texture, gradient, grain, 3D or photography.

lighting.value: None simulated. The only depth cue is the faint drop shadow under the prompt bar and the window.

styleSummary: Light, flat and typographic: near-white grounds, dark neutral grotesque, one orange that marks numbers and becomes the ground once on the drop, then a real light-theme interface at reading scale. Speed is shown with motion blur, never with effects.
